1.text: Ubwo amategeko ari igicucu cy'ibyiza bizaza akaba adafite ishusho yabyo ubwabyo, ntabwo yabasha gutunganya rwose abegera igicaniro, abatunganishije ibitambo bahora batamba uko umwaka utashye.

2.text: Iyo abibasha ntibaba bararorereye kubitamba? Kuko abasenga baba barejejwe rwose ntibabe bakimenyaho ibyaha,

3.text: ahubwo bahora bibutswa ibyaha byabo n'ibyo bitambo uko umwaka utashye.

4.text: Erega ntibishoboka ko amaraso y'amapfizi n'ay'ihene akuraho ibyaha!

5.text: Ni cyo cyatumye ubwo Yesu yazaga mu isi avuga ati“Ibitambo n'amaturo ntiwabishatse,Ahubwo wanyiteguriye umubiri.

7.text: Mperako ndavuga nti ‘Dore ndaje Mana,(Mu muzingo w'igitabo ni ko byanditswe kuri jye),Nzanywe no gukora ibyo ushaka.’ ”

8.text: Amaze kuvuga ibyo ngo “Ibitambo n'amaturo n'ibitambo byokeje, n'ibitambo by'ibyaha ntiwabishatse kandi ntiwabyishimiye”, (ari byo bitambwa nk'uko amategeko yategetse),

9.text: aherako aravuga ati “Dore nzanywe no gukora ibyo ushaka.” Akuriraho ibya mbere gukomeza ibya kabiri.

10.text: Uko gushaka kw'Imana ni ko kwatumye twezwa, tubiheshejwe n'uko umubiri wa Yesu watambwe rimwe gusa ngo bibe bihagije iteka.

11.text: Kandi umutambyi wese ahagarara iminsi yose akora umurimo we, atamba kenshi ibitambo bidahinduka bitabasha iteka kugira ubwo bikuraho ibyaha.

12.text: Ariko wa wundi amaze gutamba igitambo kimwe cy'iteka cy'ibyaha yicara iburyo bw'Imana,

13.text: ahera ubwo arindira igihe abanzi be bazashyirirwa munsi y'ibirenge bye.

14.text: Kuko abezwa yabatunganishije rwose igitambo kimwe kugeza iteka ryose.

15.text: Kandi n'Umwuka Wera ni we mugabo wo kuduhamiriza ibyo, amaze kuvuga ati

16.text: “Iri ni ryo sezerano nzasezerana na bo,Hanyuma y'iyo minsi, ni ko Uwiteka avuga,Nzashyira amategeko yanjye mu mitima yabo,Kandi mu bwenge bwabo ni ho nzayandika.”Arongera ati

18.text: Noneho rero ubwo ibyo bibababariwe, ntihakiriho kongera gutamba ibitambo by'ibyaha.

19.text: Nuko bene Data, ubwo dufite ubushizi bw'ubwoba bwo kwinjizwa Ahera cyane n'amaraso ya Yesu,

20.text: tunyuze mu nzira yaduciriye nshya kandi y'ubugingo, inyura mu mwenda ukinze ari wo mubiri we,

21.text: kandi ubwo dufite umutambyi ukomeye utwara inzu y'Imana,

22.text: twegere dufite imitima y'ukuri twizera rwose tudashidikanya, imitima yacu iminjiriweho gukurwamo kwimenyaho ibibi, n'imibiri yacu yuhagijwe amazi meza.

23.text: Dukomeze kwatura ibyiringiro byacu tutanyeganyega, kuko uwasezeranije ari uwo kwizerwa,

24.text: kandi tujye tuzirikana ubwacu kugira ngo duterane ishyaka ryo gukundana n'iry'imirimo myiza.

25.text: Twe kwirengagiza guteranira hamwe nk'uko bamwe bajya bagira, ahubwo duhugurane kandi uko mubonye urya munsi wegera, mube ari ko murushaho kugenza mutyo.

26.text: Niba dukora ibyaha nkana tumaze kumenya ukuri, ntihaba hagisigaye igitambo cy'ibyaha

27.text: keretse gutegerezanya ubwoba gucirwa ho iteka, no gutegereza umuriro w'inkazi uzarya abanzi b'Imana.

28.text: Uwasuzuguye amategeko ya Mose ko atababarirwaga, ahubwo bakamwica abagabo babiri cyangwa batatu bamushinje,

29.text: nkanswe ukandagiye Umwana w'Imana, agakerensa amaraso y'isezerano yamwejesheje, agahemura Umwuka utanga ubuntu! Ntimugira ngo azaba akwiriye igihano gikabije cyane kuruta bya bindi?

30.text: Kuko tuzi uwavuze ati “Guhōra ni ukwanjye, ni jye uzītūra.” Kandi ati “Uwiteka azacira urubanza ubwoko bwe.”

31.text: Erega biteye ubwoba gusumirwa n'amaboko y'Imana ihoraho!

32.text: Ariko mwibuke iminsi ya kera, uburyo mwihanganiraga imibabaro y'intambara nyinshi mumaze kuvirwa n'umucyo,

33.text: ubundi mugahinduka ibishungero mugatukwa mukababazwa, ubundi mugasangira imibabaro n'abagirirwa batyo.

34.text: Kuko mwababaranaga n'imbohe, mukemera munezerewe kunyagwa ibintu byanyu, mumenye yuko mufite ibindi mwabikiwe birusha ibyo kuba byiza bizahoraho.

35.text: Nuko rero ntimute ubushizi bw'ubwoba bwanyu bufite ingororano ikomeye.

36.text: Kuko mukwiriye kwihangana kugira ngo nimumara gukora ibyo Imana ishaka, muzahabwe ibyasezeranijwe.

38.text: Ariko umukiranutsi wanjye azabeshwaho no kwizera.Nyamara nasubira inyuma, umutima wanjye ntuzamwishimira.”

39.text: Ariko twebweho ntidufite gusubira inyuma ngo turimbuke, ahubwo dufite kwizera kugira ngo tuzakize ubugingo bwacu.
